dedupe_keys.name: okaa athens central markets open data monthly wholesale fish market statistics fruit vegetable and meat trade statistics and price bulletins of the rentis market 2011 to 2026

description: OKAA runs the Central Markets of Athens at Rentis and Greece's network of public wholesale fish markets, and it publishes the trade statistics of these markets. Its open data section, filterable by month and year from 2018, holds monthly statistics of wholesale fish sales at each fish market, including Piraeus, Thessaloniki, Kavala, Chalkida, Patras, Chania, Volos and Alexandroupoli, together with fruit, vegetable and meat trade statistics and consumer market prices. A separate archive of price bulletins, issued four days a week for fruit and vegetables, meat and fish, runs from 2011 to September 2026. The files are free and available to download, mostly as Excel; no licence terms are stated. Caveats: the bulletins are compiled by traders' associations, the monthly statistics lag by about three months, and file layouts differ by market. Simulation uses: modelling fresh food flows through Athens and regional wholesale hubs, testing the effect of a market closure or transport disruption on supply, and calibrating price responses in food system resilience models. Related records: the Istanbul wholesale market flows (data-ibb-istanbul-wholesale-market-flows) and Mexico's SNIIM market data (data-sniim-mexico-wholesale-market-prices-and-inflows) are comparable market data sets.
